harness.text:
param([string]$Repository)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module (Join-Path $Repository '.wac-local/Modules/Pester/5.7.1/Pester.psd1') -Force
Write-Output ('Focused shell: ' + $PSVersionTable.PSVersion)
$result = Invoke-Pester -Path (Join-Path $Repository 'tests/WinAudioClean.Batch.Tests.ps1') -TagFilter 'BatchInvalidPath' -Output Detailed -PassThru
if ($result.PassedCount -ne 4 -or $result.FailedCount -gt 0 -or $result.FailedContainersCount -gt 0 -or $result.FailedBlocksCount -gt 0) { exit 1 }
exit 0
